content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sandy Springs

steps_items.heading: 1. Verify Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background and years of hands-on project leadership. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can confirm your readiness and answer eligibility questions upfront.

steps_items.heading: 2. Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from anywhere—no travel to Sandy Springs required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world scenarios and exam-focused content over a structured schedule. You'll cover all five PMBOK® process groups and earn your required contact hours in one program.

steps_items.heading: 3. Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, complete your formal PMI application online and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance through the application portal so you understand each requirement and deadline. PMI will review and approve your eligibility within a set timeframe.

steps_items.heading: 4. Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through PMI's approved testing vendor at a location convenient to you. Use our final review support to reinforce high-risk domains and build confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: 5. Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn continuing education PDUs during your three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. PMI offers multiple pathways—education, volunteer work, and professional involvement all count. Plan your PDU strategy early and track your progress to ensure uninterrupted PMP status throughout your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
